messages.content: Solo produces JSON válido — sin prosa, sin bloques de markdown.
Produce un array JSON de 5 entradas de libros ficticios. Cada uno tiene los campos: title (string), author (string), year (int 1800-2024), genres (array de 1-3 strings), rating (float 1.0-5.0).

message.content:
<think>The user wants a JSON array with 5 entries of fictional books. Each entry must have the fields: title (string), author (string), year (int between 1800 and 2024), genres (array of 1-3 strings), rating (float between 1.0 and 5.0). They want the output as JSON, no markdown, no prose. Just a JSON array.

We must produce a valid JSON array with 5 objects. Ensure each field is correct. Use realistic-sounding but fictional titles and authors. Provide plausible years in range. Provide genres arrays with 1-3 strings. Provide rating floats between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive.

We must not output any extra text. Just the JSON. Let's craft:

1. Title: "The Clockwork Cipher", author: "Evelyn Marsh", year: 1847, genres: ["Mystery", "Steampunk"], rating: 4.2

2. Title: "Echoes of the Void", author: "Liora Nightshade", year: 1993, genres: ["Science Fiction", "Horror"], rating: 4.8

3. Title: "The Last Ember", author: "Caspian Thorne", year: 2015, genres: ["Fantasy"], rating: 3.9

4. Title: "Shadows of the Silk Road", author: "Mira Okafor", year: 2006, genres: ["Historical Fiction", "Adventure"], rating: 4.5

5. Title: "The Gilded Masquerade", author: "Jasper L. Quinn", year: 1879, genres: ["Gothic", "Romance", "Mystery"], rating: 3.6

Check constraints: year between 1800-2024 inclusive. All
